course_name_original: MECANICA DEL SUELO Y CIMENTACIONES ESPECIALES

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to control projects and their execution.
Ability to prepare projects, direct works and build.
Knowledge and ability to choose the most appropriate foundation typology for particular conditions.
Knowledge of the applicable regulations for the design and calculation of foundations and for the preparation of geotechnical studies.
Ability to interpret and generate construction plans.
Ability to draft geotechnical studies and to design and calculate foundations for buildings and machines.

syllabus_topics: Bernoulli's Theorem. Water at rest. Piezometric head
Water flow in the ground. Permeability
Behavior of soils subjected to shear
Expansive clays. Saline and aggressive soils. Collapsible soils. Very soft and sensitive soils and sludges
Construction systems and field of application
assessment_rules: Each assessable activity is graded out of 10. Class exercises collectively account for 10% of the continuous assessment, and controls for 36%. The global exam is worth 54% of the total evaluation. To pass the course, a minimum weighted average score of 5 points is required, along with a minimum of 4 in the theory part of the global exam; otherwise, the final grade will be capped at 4.5. In the extraordinary July resit, the exam accounts for 100% of the course grade, with a minimum of 4 in the theory part required to pass, otherwise the grade will not exceed 4.5.
